From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightlane.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick intro + 15-min discovery to map fit

Hi Liam —

Thanks for agreeing to a short intro. I sent a calendar invite for today at 10:00am PT to walk through your use case and show a 10-minute demo of Redwood Inference. High-level agenda:

- Quick context on BrightLane’s goals (you)
- How we handle low-latency inference for multi-tenant SaaS
- A two-minute walkthrough of cost/levers (batching, KV caching)
- Next steps / mutual action plan

If anything changes, no problem — just reply or use this self-serve link to pick another slot: https://cal.redwood.com/s/monica/15

I attached a one-pager so you can skim before the call.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: discovery-prep-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightlane.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 10:05:23 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up — missed our 10:00am PT call

Hi Liam,

I missed you on our 10:00am PT call — hope everything is okay on your end. I left a quick voicemail with a brief summary and next-step options (attached).

Two fast paths to reconnect:

1) Quick 15-min slot today or tomorrow — pick here: https://cal.redwood.com/s/monica/15
2) If you'd like to see the exact demo I planned, here's a 3-minute recording: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1DemoRecordingPreview
3) If timing is tight, reply with 3 windows and I'll lock one in.

If the conversation isn't relevant, no worries — just let me know and I won't follow up. If you are still evaluating, I'll bring a short checklist that maps to cost/levers and security controls most teams ask about (SOC2, data retention).

Quick recap of what I planned to cover:
- Typical latency & cost optimizations for chat/seq2seq workloads
- Dedicated vs hosted deployment choices for data isolation
- What we ask for during a POC (small dataset, goals, success metrics)

Thanks — voicemail attached.

Best,
Monica
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
Attachments: voicemail-20251009.mp3 (audio, 1.2MB)
